entries.name: BILL_CLIENT_ID
entries.description: The client id of a BILL developer app made with accounting data access. It is sent to BILL only, with the secret, to sign in.
howToGet: Sign in to the BILL web app as a user who can see bills, vendors and payments, and create a developer app there, as BILL's OAuth client credentials guide at developer.bill.com describes.
Name the app for KaratOS and choose Accounting data access, which leaves out payment creation and funding account updates. Never choose Full access.

entries.name: BILL_CLIENT_SECRET
entries.description: The developer app's client secret. BILL has no read-only option; with accounting data access it can't create payments or change funding accounts, and the connector only ever reads.
howToGet: Copy the client secret BILL shows when the app is created. It lasts two years; make a new one before then.
Put it straight into the instance's Railway variables. Never send it by chat or email.

entries.name: BILL_ENVIRONMENT
entries.description: production (the default) reads the business's BILL organization; sandbox uses BILL's sandbox, with a sandbox app's id and secret.
howToGet: Leave unset for the live organization.
